title: Tsubasa RESERVoir CHRoNiCLE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Princess Sakura of Clow loses her memories, which scatter as feathers across many worlds. Her childhood friend Syaoran, the ninja Kurogane and the magician Fai pay prices to the Dimensional Witch Yuko for the power to travel and recover them. Crossing worlds drawn from other CLAMP series, they discover that Syaoran is a clone made by the sorcerer Fei-Wang Reed, and the story turns toward identity, sacrifice and the impossibility of undoing death.
life_message: Bonds chosen and kept through loss give life meaning; the past cannot be undone, only lived forward.

Chaste Syaoran-Sakura romance; Kurogane-Fai bond read as subtext (AniList Boys' Love 60); MangaDex 'safe'.
Fai's guilt and wish to die; memory loss and identity crisis (to verify).
Crossover with xxxHolic and other CLAMP works; anime, OVAs, film.
